headline: A walking, talking Figure 03 humanoid escorted Melania Trump into a White House technology summit.
score_reason: Striking public demonstration, but a staged appearance from 30 Sep 2026, before today's window, with no technical detail.
importance_line: Humanoid robots are now political showpieces as well as factory prototypes, which raises public familiarity and gives US maker Figure a stage, though a scripted walk-on says little about what the robot can do unscripted.
summary: ABC7 reports that on 30 Sep 2026 First Lady Melania Trump entered the White House East Room side by side with Figure 03, a humanoid robot built by the US company Figure, which greeted guests in several languages, waved, and then walked itself back out of the room. The appearance opened the second day of her technology summit for leaders' spouses from 45 nations, and she called the machine her "first American-made humanoid guest in the White House".
notes: Event on 30 Sep 2026; score lowered from 5 to 4 as stale. Possibly an AP wire story carried by ABC7; no credit visible in the text.
